articles.title: Samsung integrates USDC to overhaul cross-border remittances for 82 million Galaxy users
articles.snippet: Eligible users will be able to send USDC abroad or send local-currency payouts to bank accounts in more than 60 countries, starting late October.

articles.title: Samsung Wallet to add USDC transfers for US Galaxy users in October
articles.snippet: Eligible US Galaxy will be able to send USDC to crypto wallets and transfer funds to bank accounts in more than 60 countries.

articles.title: Samsung Wallet Taps Solana for USDC Transfers on 82M US Galaxy Devices
articles.snippet: Users can send USDC across borders from late October, three months after Samsung teased stablecoin support without naming a blockchain.
